# `oaap external`

the node's public hostname and TLS, also behind an edge (RFC-0006).

**Root:** needs `sudo`.

## Usage

```sh
oaap external [--behind-edge BEHIND_EDGE]
                     {show,set,remove} [hostname]
```

## Arguments

| Argument | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `action` | what to do -- see Actions below |
| `hostname` | -- |
| `--behind-edge BEHIND_EDGE` | edge node's IP address (RFC-0006: TLS terminates at the edge) |

## Actions

Whether an action needs `sudo` is read from the rule the node enforces, with the other arguments left out (e.g. `node care` reads, `node care measure` needs `sudo`).

| Action | Needs `sudo` |
|---|---|
| `show` | yes |
| `set` | yes |
| `remove` | yes |
